+import { applyTransform } from "jscodeshift/src/testUtils"
+import * as mod from "./src/transforms/v1/file-logger"
+
+const run = (source: string) =>
+    applyTransform(mod as any, {}, { source, path: "test.ts" }, { parser: "tsx" })
+
+const cases: [string, string, boolean][] = [
+  ["named-noopts", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all")`, true],
+  ["named-noargs", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger()`, true],
+  ["aliased", `import { FileLogger as FL } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FL("all", { logPath: "./x" })`, true],
+  ["namespace", `import * as typeorm from "typeorm"\nconst l = new typeorm.FileLogger("all")`, true],
+  ["cjs-destructure", `const { FileLogger } = require("typeorm")\nconst l = new FileLogger("all")`, true],
+  ["cjs-alias", `const { FileLogger: FL } = require("typeorm")\nconst l = new FL("all")`, true],
+  ["cjs-whole", `const typeorm = require("typeorm")\nconst l = new typeorm.FileLogger("all")`, true],
+  ["undefined-opts", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", undefined)`, true],
+  ["null-opts", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", null)`, true],
+  ["empty-obj", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", {})`, true],
+  ["logpath-undef", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { logPath: undefined })`, true],
+  ["relative", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { logPath: "logs/a.log" })`, true],
+  ["spread+rel", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { ...o, logPath: "./a" })`, true],
+  // negatives
+  ["absolute", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { logPath: "/var/log/a" })`, false],
+  ["unc", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { logPath: "\\\\\\\\srv\\\\s" })`, false],
+  ["only-spread", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { ...o })`, false],
+  ["nonliteral", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nimport path from "path"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", { logPath: path.resolve("x") })`, false],
+  ["dynvar", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all", opts)`, false],
+  ["other-pkg", `import { FileLogger } from "other"\nconst l = new FileLogger("all")`, false],
+  ["multi-one-stmt", `import { FileLogger } from "typeorm"\nconst a = [new FileLogger(), new FileLogger("all")]`, true],

+  const pass = changed === expectChange && (nm !== "multi-one-stmt" || count === 1)

+  console.log(`${pass ? "PASS" : "FAIL"} ${nm} changed=${changed} count=${count}`)
+  if (!pass) console.log(out)
+}
